parts.name: wood_frangipani
sources: The flowers are 5 to 7.5 cm across, 5 petals, white with a yellow center (Criley, 1998; the Flora of China 16).
It flowers from May to August in Việt Nam (Cây thuốc và động vật làm thuốc ở Việt Nam, tập 1).

Each shoot ends in a cluster of flowers, then 2 or 3 new shoots grow from under it: the model of Leeuwenberg (Hallé, Oldeman and Tomlinson, Tropical Trees and Forests, 1978); the model forks 5 times, in 3, 3, 2, 2 and 2.
3 to 8 m (Criley, Plumeria, University of Hawai'i CTAHR OF-24, 1998); 3 to 7 m (Cây thuốc và động vật làm thuốc ở Việt Nam, tập 1).
The leaves are 14 to 30 by 6 to 8 cm, the petiole 5 to 7 cm, in clusters at the ends of the branches (Shiu-Ying Hu Herbarium, Plumeria rubra, from the Flora of China 16).
Plumeria rubra drops its leaves in the dry season (December to April in the South of Việt Nam); the months with no leaves are an estimate.
The branches are thick, blunt and brittle (Criley, 1998); the trunk of 22 cm is an estimate.
